items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I'll go to Chani Bebe's wife on one of them. His wife played Dan? Yeah. D.D.'s sister. What's her name? D.D.'s wife was named Crosby last time.

ctx.x: Whose bands were you? Just pick up bands.
I'll go to Chani Bebe's wife on one of them. His wife played Dan? Yeah. D.D.'s sister. What's her name? D.D.'s wife was named Crosby last time. Uh-huh. Huh?
No, I wouldn't have been Goodson originally, but... But I don't know, there was a Sadie Crosby in that somewhere.
